checks.name: Additive migration keeps the existing 390k shared reservation and enables RLS on all 16 new tables
Guests may read shared data but cannot write it, read private history, or inspect capability/budget tables
The public invoker wrapper requires the real scoped capability before any status or write
All college warehouse families accept properly sourced CFB identifiers and preserve cross-sport foreign keys
NFL/CFB sportsbook references and percentage event contracts cannot be relabeled across venues or instruments
Duplicate quote/source identities preserve immutable observed prices and reject changed definitions
Every shared quote/source/entity/cache boundary rejects credentials and private financial/owner payloads
Bounded public cache and batches are atomic, CFB-scoped and cannot nest control operations
450MB reserve denial blocks every source/entity/quote/cache/batch write while saved reads remain available
Tiny quota metadata shares the preserved 500k UTC budget: 390k→400k→450k, with no free retry or negative counts
Only exact small reservation fields are allowed; no owner, source, job output or caller-supplied UTC day enters quota metadata
Fenced completion/failure preserves spent quota and completed/failed cache loss never re-executes uncharged work
Private CFB simulation/prediction records enforce owner RLS, composite ownership FKs and prospective immutable snapshots

note: Checks validate PostgreSQL storage, permissions and quota semantics, not model accuracy or physical iPhone use. 100000 is accepted for a private simulation record; a new public 100000 reservation is correctly blocked when 450000/500000 is already spent.
